title: EasyMOTD-Fuchsi
description: A small, simple, and high-performance Paper/Spigot plugin for creating colorful server descriptions.
body:
### 🎨 EasyMOTD

**EasyMOTD** is a **high-performance** Paper/Spigot plugin that lets you make your server **colorful and unique** in the server list.

**EasyMOTD allows** you to fully **customize** your server **description (MOTD)** – with vibrant colors, color gradients.

---

### ⚠️ Config Notice

In the automatically generated config.yml, I have included a direct link **to a website** to make it easier for you to generate color codes.
**_Important: This website is NOT created by me – big thanks to the creator of this tool!_**

---
### 🐛 Bugs & Features

**Please** be **understanding** if you encounter **any bugs** – I am still new to plugin development.
If you **find bugs** or have **feature requests**, feel free to contact me. I will do my **best** to implement them.



**© 2025 Developed by Fuchsi5000 with ❤️.**
